items.title: US Senate Leadership Throws Weight Behind Renewed Russia Sanctions Push
items.description: Senate Republican leadership has thrown its weight behind a renewed bipartisan push to impose sweeping new sanctions on Russia that supporters say marks the strongest congressional effort yet to increase economic pressure on Moscow over its war against Ukraine.

items.title: At least one dead in Texas floods ravaging same area where campers died
items.description: The same area devastated by floods last year's floods, which caused more than 130 deaths, is once again being hit.

items.title: Boris Nadezhdin is a rare Russian politician speaking out against the Ukraine war
items.description: Boris Nadezhdin wants to run for Russia's parliament on a platform that gives voice to the Russians against the war in Ukraine. That's why, he says, the Kremlin is doing everything to stop him.

items.title: Monaco assassination plot takes a new turn
items.description: A woman suspected of plotting to assassinate a Ukrainian-Cypriot businessman in Monaco has been found dead in Ukraine. Two men with ties to Ukraine's intelligence services have now been brought into custody.

items.title: Russia Fires 6,001 Drones, 170 Bombs as Ukraine Repels 235 Clashes
items.description: The Armed Forces of Ukraine repelled 235 clashes across the front line on Wednesday, July 15, with the heaviest fighting near Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka. Russian forces used 170 guided bombs and 6,001 kamikaze drones during the assault.
